kind: Authored public-development varied curriculum; same sixteen facts, case identities and 48 encounters; one fixed rendition per document and question; only document and request fields differ from compact.

training.name: learn-abri-transport
training.request: Use the transport choice that carries abri's traffic between services.
training.document: Audit records from abri carry the label beryl. For transport, abri uses azurite. The service cevu sends traffic between services using coral; its audit records are tagged flint.

training.name: learn-dofi-transport
training.request: Find dofi's transport setting in the maintenance notes and apply it.
training.document: Although enko is listed first in the maintenance notes, dofi's transport setting is jasper. Dofi labels its audit records kaolin. For enko, mica identifies audit records, while lapis handles transport.

training.name: learn-falu-transport
training.request: Set falu to its assigned transport choice.
training.document: For falu, opal is the label attached to its audit records; the transport assigned to falu is ochre. Gemi uses pearl when sending interservice traffic. Its audit label, ruby, is recorded alongside that choice.

training.name: learn-horo-transport
training.request: Which documented setting carries horo's communication between services? Apply it as the transport choice.
training.document: The service itva retains stibnite as its transport setting during maintenance. Itva marks audit records with gesso. Horo's audit label is zinc; for communication between services, horo uses talc.
